sources.excerpt: Lichtlaerm Audio Altar | LICHTLÆRM AUDIO Cart 0 News Artists About Contact Shop Back About FAQ Cart 0 News Artists About About FAQ Somic Doom Devices | handmade in Berlin Contact Shop Shop Altar – Dual Gain Monolith | Boost · Fuzz · Distortion Previous Gehenna - Metal Distortion / Preamp Next The Key and the Gate – Signal Guardian | Transparent Noise Gate · Single-Knob Precision Altar – Dual Gain Monolith | Boost · Fuzz · Distortion Altar – Dual Gain Monolith | Boost · Fuzz · Distortion €199.00 incl. EU VAT/Mwst., plus shipping Bring your sacrifices unto the Altar… and immanentize the eschaton. The Altar is not a pedal — it’s a ritual. A relic. A weapon forged from fire, thunder, and saturated chaos. The latest incarnation of our dual-channel behemoth fuses searing high-gain fuzz/distortion with a colossal clean boost , designed to crush amps, split skies, and blur the line between musical expression and sonic blasphemy. At its core, the fuzz circuit is a loosely summoned spirit of the Black Russian Big Muff — stretched, mangled, and reborn. From soaring Gilmourian sustain to molten doom-soaked riffage , sludge , stoner , and noise rock madness , this is your go-to for tone that refuses to behave. Refined by Fire Earlier versions served both guitar and bass alike. This new evolution is more focused — the guitar version leads the charge, bringing tighter control and a voice tailored for six-string prophecy. The Blend knob is gone, replaced by a 3-band active EQ with ±18dB of cut/boost across Bass, Mids, and Treble — perfectly voiced for sculpting anything from classic scooped Muff roars to aggressive, mix-cutting fuzz with laser-focused mids. The Depth control lets you dial in saturation character — from tight, amp-like drive to blown-out, speaker-destroying fuzz filth. The EQ section is insanely powerful . Push it hard for extremes — fuzz with hi-fi clarity, or doom that sounds like tectonic plates grinding beneath you. The Sacred Control: COMP Introducing a new proprietary control : the COMP knob. This is your secret weapon — a morphing circuit that shifts the Altar's personality across an entire spectrum of gain. Blend from raw, dynamic distortion , to dry and violent Muff-style aggression , to smooth, organic Germanium-like overdrive . It’s not just a sound — it’s a shapeshifter. And to fuel this wild ride, the Altar boosts your 9V supply internally to a bone-crushing 36V , granting massive headroom , clarity , and brutal loudness . We’re not saying this is the loudest Muff-inspired pedal ever built. We’re saying no other one dares to be this loud. Enter the DOOM Inside lies a forbidden rite — the DOOM switch . Flip it, and the gain stages plunge into beast mode. It alters the corner frequencies of the circuit, shifting from mid-forward Sovtek crunch to a low-end hammer that sends everything through the clipping stage. It’s like detuning reality. Independently Usable Clean Boost The Boost circuit is a standalone leviathan: up to +36dB of clean push with a secret agenda — it subtly excites upper harmonics, mangles fuzz textures, and sends tube amps into frenzy. Combine with the fuzz for infinite sustain , square-wave chaos , and even death metal style gnarlyness . Grind control warps the boost’s EQ curve — from near-flat to a brutal HM-2-style scoop that turns your tone into serrated concrete. Think chainsaw tones buried in molten tar. The Altar was our first-born — and with this version, it has ascended. It’s no longer just a fuzz. It’s not even just a distortion or overdrive. It’s a temple of tone, a heretical monument to Pink Floyd , Entombed , Bongripper , or even your most soul-crushing dad-rock licks. One box. A thousand voices.
